name: finpack-claude
description: Lean, token-efficient agents and skills for daily Claude Code development. Install the whole kit by cloning the repo, or pick individual plugins from this marketplace.

plugins.name: fp-code-reviewer
plugins.description: Reviews code for real bugs: off-by-ones, null derefs, race conditions, swallowed errors. Skips style nitpicks.

plugins.name: fp-security-reviewer
plugins.description: OWASP-style review: injection, auth, data exposure, weak crypto. Severity-ranked with file:line + fix.

plugins.name: fp-performance-reviewer
plugins.description: Finds real bottlenecks. DB N+1, memory leaks, blocking calls, re-renders.

plugins.name: fp-doc-reviewer
plugins.description: Cross-references docs against actual source. Flags drift, missing params, dead references.

plugins.name: fp-plan-reviewer
plugins.description: Reviews a plan or expedition steps for executable completeness, risk, and scope drift. Returns a READY | REVISE verdict so a planning loop can terminate.

plugins.name: fp-frontend-designer
plugins.description: Builds production-grade UI. Tokens-first, anti-AI-slop aesthetics, design tokens enforced.

plugins.name: fp-swiftui-designer
plugins.description: Builds polished SwiftUI UI/UX for iPhone and iPad. HIG-driven, size-class adaptive, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver ready.

plugins.name: fp-code-architect
plugins.description: Designs a feature architecture implementation blueprint by analyzing existing codebase patterns. Used by /counsel-quest during architecture design.

plugins.name: fp-code-explorer
plugins.description: Deeply analyzes existing codebase features by tracing execution paths, mapping architecture layers, and documenting dependencies. Used by /counsel-quest during codebase exploration.

plugins.name: setup-finpack
plugins.description: Bootstrap and customize finpack-claude in any project. Copies the full template into .claude/ if missing, then tunes every config file to match your stack.

plugins.name: debug-fix
plugins.description: Find and fix a bug. Default is the careful path (reproduce, investigate, test). Add `--fast` for emergency hotfix mode.

plugins.name: tdd
plugins.description: Strict red-green-refactor TDD loop. Failing test, then minimum code, then refactor. Commits after each cycle.

plugins.name: explain
plugins.description: Explain code with one-sentence summary, mental model, ASCII diagram, and modification guide.

plugins.name: session-audit
plugins.description: Audit recent Claude Code sessions for recurring friction, then propose new skills, automations, and CLAUDE.md fixes. Report-only unless --fix.

plugins.name: test-writer
plugins.description: Write comprehensive tests covering happy/edge/error/concurrency paths. Verifies tests actually catch bugs.

plugins.name: quest-system
plugins.description: RPG-themed epic and session management for mono-repo development.

plugins.name: install-quest-system
plugins.description: Bootstrap quest-system in any project. Copies all seven command files to .claude/commands/ in one step.

plugins.name: update-quest-system
plugins.description: Update installed quest-system files to the latest version from source or GitHub. Overwrites command files, skills, the fp- agent suite, and the verifier hook.
